.widget-90anos {
    position: fixed;
    width: 80px;

.widget-90anos-btn {
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    border: none;
}
.logo-90 {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    width: 68%;
}
.square-green {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    border-radius: 5px;
    transform: rotate(45deg);    
    transition: transform 150ms ease-in-out;
}
.square-orange {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    border-radius: 5px;    
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
.pop-90-noticias {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 150px;
    right: 20px;
    background: #ffffff;
    width: 500px;
    height: 40vh;
    max-width: 90%;
    z-index: 100000000000;
    border-radius: 5px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
}
.pop-90-noticias.show {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    -webkit-animation: scale-in-br 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.250, 0.460, 0.450, 0.940) both;
    animation: scale-in-br 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.250, 0.460, 0.450, 0.940) both;
}
.pop-90-noticias-header {
    background: #004282;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.pop-90-noticias-header h3 {
    color: #fff;
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 700;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif !important;
}

.pop-90-noticias-header h3 small a {
    display: block;
    background: #fff;
    margin: 10px 0 0;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 400;
    padding: 7px 10px;
    border-radius: 5px;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: all 250ms;
    color: #004282;
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif !important;
}

.pop-90-noticias-header h3 small a:hover {
    background: #c6e1fb;
}

.pop-90-noticias-header button {
    position: absolute;
    right: 20px;
    background: #ffffff3b;
    width: 35px;
    height: 35px;
    border-radius: 100%;
    font-size: 30px !important;
    transform: rotate(45deg);
    line-height: 0 !important;
    color: #fff;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif !important;
    border: none;
    display: block;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

.pop-90-noticia-item a {
    display: flex;
    gap: 20px;
}

.pop-90-noticia-img {
    width: 100px;
    height: 66px;
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    border-radius: 5px;
}
.pop-90-noticias-lista-container {
    padding: 20px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    height: 100%;
}

.pop-90-noticia-texto p:first-child {
    background: #004282;
    display: inline-block;
    margin: 0 0 5px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: #fff;
}

.pop-90-noticia-texto p:last-child {
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #004282;
}

li.pop-90-noticia-item {
    margin-bottom: 19px;
    list-style: none;
}
